lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot alignments, particularly in the mid-to-upper flank region, creating high-luminance anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition, with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and a narrow shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with higher density visible towards the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, small-scale high-luminance patterning on the leading pectoral fin, distinct in scale from the primary flank constellation.
